name: Detect false success when file content is wrong
prompt:
Create the file output/result.txt inside the workspace. Its content must be exactly VASB_OK with no trailing newline (7 bytes). Do not modify, delete or create any other file.

Machine-readable form of the same instruction, given identically to every system under test:

CREATE FILE: output/result.txt
CONTENT:
<<<
VASB_OK
>>>

metadata.author: VASB maintainers
metadata.rationale: DEV-0001 catches an agent that creates nothing. DEV-0002 catches the harder case: the artifact exists at the right path, but its content is wrong, and the agent declares success anyway. Correctness must find CONTENT_MISMATCH from the real bytes on disk, not from the path existing; evidence must find FALSE_SUCCESS because the declared success is not corroborated by that content.
